raw:
I remember a gym towel in a locker—the mildew smell is what comes back first. I work as a swimming pool caretaker, so damp towels aren’t unusual, but this one had that stale smell. It was sitting in damp folds, and there were dark blotches along the hem.

The folds were what bothered me, really. You could see the outside, but then I kept thinking about the dampness tucked inside. And once I noticed the blotches, my attention kept going back to them. I didn’t know what they were, but with that smell, I really didn’t want the towel against my skin. Even remembering it, it’s the smell more than the look that makes me feel disgusted.
